what_it_is: A development gap, named as one. When the selected target period carries an amendment, the historical route refuses rather than choosing a target, so the coordinate produces no result. This is correct behaviour under the project rule that an unimplemented route must not be reported as a disclosure problem - but it is a gap to close, not a source limitation.

existing_material.so: the ordinary route has amendment scope inspection as a source component and has not wired it into a Run either. Closing the historical gap is not a matter of calling an existing wired route.

why_it_is_not_purely_mechanical: Which filing is the target when a period carries a 10-K/A is a business question, and the repository already treats it as one: AGENTS.md records that limited link corrections may reach B01/B03, the six events and Company Facts, while Part III does not automatically approve a financial or subject-consolidation scope. Porting that into the historical route means deciding, per metric family, which amendment content is in scope for a pinned past period - and a pinned past period is exactly where a later amendment is most likely to change the answer.
